singleton_slice.definition: Canonical CNF formulas whose R44BW explicit binary-equality congruence classes are all singleton classes.
singleton_slice.hard_subslice: Canonical exact-3-CNF: every retained clause has exactly three distinct variables and no tautology.
singleton_slice.reason: R44BW only discovers equalities from certified binary clause pairs, so an exact-3-CNF input contains no source binary equality certificates.
singleton_slice.expected_identity: For every exact-3-CNF F, Q_BW(F) = dense_rename(F).

compression_lane.candidate_requirement: A nontrivial polynomial-time computable representation C(F) on the singleton slice.
compression_lane.algorithmic_authority_requirement: There exists a proved polynomial-time decider D with D(C(F))=SAT(F) for every input in the slice.
compression_lane.kill_condition: Any exact mixed fiber C(F_sat)=C(F_unsat) quarantines C for SAT decision authority.

direct_decider_lane.required_result: A total polynomial-time decision algorithm D_Q operating directly on Q(F), not a polynomial witness verifier and not an exponential fallback.
direct_decider_lane.reduction_obligation: Because exact-3-CNF survives R44BW up to dense renaming, D_Q on all quotient images would decide exact-3SAT in polynomial time.
